children: The FTSE 100 Index decreased 59 points or 0.55 percent on Thursday to close at 10611 points.
The decline was led by Associated British Foods (-7.92%), Antofagasta (-5.68%) and Anglo American (-4.86%).
On the upside, the strongest performers were Compass (1.83%), Vodafone (1.66%) and Imperial Brands (1.43%).

title: The FTSE 100 Index Closes 0.55% Lower
